title: Off-by-one in range sum
bugDescription: Loop terminates at i < n instead of i <= n, omitting n from the sum.
description: Calculate the sum of all integers from 0 up to and including n.
hints: Check your loop termination condition: should it be i <= n?

title: Wrong Comparison in Binary Search
bugDescription: Loop condition low < high skips when low equals high, and low = mid causes infinite loops.
description: Find the 0-based index of target in a sorted array, or -1 if absent.
hints: The while loop condition must be low <= high with low = mid + 1 and high = mid - 1.

title: Wrong Operator in Leap Year Calculation
bugDescription: Uses || instead of && for the century rule, declaring years like 1900 as leap years.
description: Determine if a given year is a leap year in the Gregorian calendar.
hints: A leap year is divisible by 4 AND NOT divisible by 100, UNLESS divisible by 400.

title: Mutated Array in Duplicate Removal
bugDescription: Mutates array via splice while advancing index i++, skipping adjacent duplicate values.
description: Return a new array containing only the unique elements of the input in their original order.
hints: Avoid mutating arrays while iterating. You can use new Set(arr).

title: Wrong Comparison in Clamp Function
bugDescription: Reverses bounds checking, returning max when val is below min and min when val is above max.
description: Restrict a numeric value to lie within inclusive lower and upper limits.
hints: Use Math.min and Math.max to constrain val.

title: Off-by-one in Array Chunking
bugDescription: Loop steps by 1 (i++) instead of step size (i += size), producing overlapping subarrays.
description: Split an array into chunks of the given size. The final chunk may contain fewer elements.
hints: Advance the loop with i += size.

title: Edge Case in Falsy Value Filtering
bugDescription: Only checks for null and undefined, leaving 0, false, and empty strings.
description: Filter out all falsy values (false, null, 0, "", undefined, and NaN) from an array.
hints: Use arr.filter(Boolean).

title: Wrong Comparison in Maximum Subarray Sum
bugDescription: Initializes max sum to 0, failing when all numbers in the array are negative.
description: Find the maximum sum of a contiguous non-empty subarray using Kadane's algorithm.
hints: Initialize maxSoFar and current to nums[0], not 0.

title: Mutated Shared State in Deep Clone
bugDescription: Uses Object.assign which performs shallow cloning and crashes on null.
description: Create an independent deep copy of objects and arrays without mutating originals.
hints: Handle null explicitly, check Array.isArray, and recurse on properties.

title: Off-by-one in Flatten Array with Depth
bugDescription: Omits base case depth <= 0 and fails to decrement depth on recursion.
description: Flatten nested array elements up to the specified positive integer depth limit.
hints: Add if (depth <= 0) return arr.slice(); and recurse with depth - 1.

title: Async/Await Mistake in Sequential Task Runner
bugDescription: Uses forEach with an async callback; forEach does not await promises and returns immediately.
description: Multiply each item by multiplier sequentially with async delay and return the array of results.
hints: Replace forEach with a standard for...of loop to properly await each step.

title: Wrong Operator in Merge Intervals
bugDescription: Fails to sort intervals by start time first, breaking when intervals are received out of order.
description: Merge all overlapping intervals into non-overlapping intervals.
hints: Sort intervals by start time: intervals.slice().sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]).

title: Mutated State in Object GroupBy
bugDescription: Directly assigns result[key] = item, overwriting previous items instead of collecting an array.
description: Group an array of objects by property key into an object of arrays.
hints: Initialize result[k] = result[k] || [] before pushing item.

title: Async/Await Mistake in Promise Delay
bugDescription: Does not await the Promise inside the loop, pushing pending Promise objects to the array.
description: Multiply each value by 2 after a simulated delay and return resolved values.
hints: Add await before new Promise(...).

title: Wrong Comparison in Object Deep Equality
bugDescription: Performs shallow comparison !== on object keys, and crashes when evaluating null.
description: Determine whether two objects or values are deeply equivalent.
hints: Check if a === null || b === null first, then recurse with isDeepEqual(a[k], b[k]).

title: Edge Case in Word Frequency Counter
bugDescription: Fails to sanitize casing or punctuation, and collides with Object prototype keys like constructor.
description: Count the frequency of each alphanumeric word in a string, ignoring punctuation and casing.
hints: Normalize casing toLowerCase(), strip punctuation, and use Object.create(null).

title: Mutated State in LRU Cache Eviction
bugDescription: get(key) fails to refresh key recency, and put() deletes the newest element instead of oldest.
description: Execute get/put operations on an LRU Cache with the given capacity, returning an array of get results.
hints: In a JavaScript Map, map.keys().next().value is the oldest entry. Delete and re-set on access.

title: Async/Await Mistake in Promise.allSettled
bugDescription: Uses Promise.all directly, which rejects immediately on first error instead of capturing status.
description: Capture the outcome of all async items, returning an array with status 'fulfilled' or 'rejected'.
hints: Attach .then(v => ({ status: 'fulfilled', value: v })).catch(r => ({ status: 'rejected', reason: String(r) })).

title: Wrong Operator in Course Schedule Cycle Detection
bugDescription: Reverses prerequisite graph edge direction, causing topological sort to output in reverse dependency order.
description: Return a valid course schedule order using topological sort, or [] if impossible due to a cycle.
hints: Only push a neighbor to the queue when its inDegree reaches exactly 0.

title: Async/Await Mistake in Task Batching
bugDescription: Omits await on chunk execution, pushing unresolved Promise objects into the batch array.
description: Process array items in sequential batches of batchSize, awaiting each batch before continuing.

hiddenTests.name: Batch size larger than items length

hints: Iterate in steps of batchSize and await Promise.all on each chunk.
